comments.body: I don’t think the nuclear industry is booming in Switzerland. But you have a labor issue with finding people to maintain or decommission what Switzerland has. I can’t say if the shortage is severe enough to warrant non-EEA working permits. In other countries in Europe you have a serious issue finding nuclear engineers, as nobody wanted to invest into nuclear after Fukushima. A bunch of people retired/left the sector, and now suddenly there is a nuclear revival. Going to be interesting when Switzerland actually decides to build a new plant. I think that will happen somehow in the next 10 years…
comments.author: DVUZT
